For instance, the proposed test does not account for potential delays in reporting or editorial reinterpretations of the ECB’s stated rationale. 2. **Missing Control:** The proposed test lacks a **baseline verification step** for the ECB’s *official communications*. The ECB publishes press releases, policy decisions, and governor statements on its [official website](https://www.ecb.europa.eu), which should be the first point of reference. Failing to anchor the comparison to this source risks circular confirmation bias—if the relay’s secondary sources all cite the ECB indirectly, their agreement may reflect a shared error rather than consensus. **Concrete Gap:** - **Step 0 (Pre-requisite):** Retrieve and compare the exact wording of the ECB’s [press release](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pressreleases/html/index.en.html) or [policy decision](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/mopo/dec/html/index.en.html) from the relevant date (likely September 2026, given the cycle timestamp).
